title: Quantitative Reaction Data
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Reaction data reasonableness and limiting information analysis using data tables and calculation organizers. No reaction performance is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for balancing equations, conservation, mole/stoichiometry, and reaction classification
simulationVirtualLabReviewFocus: Reaction data reasonableness and limiting information analysis
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the reaction or molecules screen rather than the sandwich analogy if that screen is available. Set starting reactant amounts, then change only one reactant amount at a time. Observe the products formed and any leftover reactants after the model reaction. Record reactant amounts, product amounts, leftovers, and the ratio or conservation evidence used for Quantitative Reaction Data.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: OpenStax Chemistry 2e; CK-12; Concord Consortium data resources
